name: hover-card
title: HoverCard
description: A preview of what a link points to, on Base UI's PreviewCard: shown while the pointer rests on the link or the link has keyboard focus, styled as a Popover, size.panel.sm wide.

manifest.name: hover-card
manifest.title: HoverCard
manifest.description: A preview of what a link points to, on Base UI's PreviewCard: shown while the pointer rests on the link or the link has keyboard focus, styled as a Popover, size.panel.sm wide.
manifest.usage: Use HoverCard to preview the target of a link without leaving the page: a table name in a message, a foreign key, a connection in the status bar. Compose it as HoverCard > HoverCardTrigger (the link: href and the page's link classes) + HoverCardContent (side, align) with read-only content. The link must work without the card and the card must not hold anything the user needs to click: it disappears when the pointer leaves. For a label on an icon button use Tooltip; for controls the user clicks to open, Popover.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when hover, focus, Escape or a press opens or closes it.

props.name: delay
props.description: HoverCardTrigger: ms of hover before it opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: HoverCardTrigger: ms before it closes after the pointer leaves (the pointer can move into the card).

props.name: href
props.description: HoverCardTrigger: the link's target; the link works without the card.

props.name: side
props.description: HoverCardContent: the side of the link; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: align
props.description: HoverCardContent: how it lines up with the link.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal, at z.popover, with the link's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="hover-card-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: The card: color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay, size.panel.sm wide; data-slot="hover-card-content".

parts.name: HoverCardTrigger
parts.description: The link (an <a>); give it href and the page's link classes.

parts.name: HoverCardContent
parts.description: The portal, the positioner and the card.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: Popover's scale and fade over motion.duration.base; reduced motion turns it off.

accessibility: The trigger is an ordinary link, named by its text; it works (Enter follows it) whether or not the card opens.
The card opens on hover after delay and on keyboard focus of the link; Escape closes it and focus stays on the link; leaving the link and the card closes it after closeDelay.
The card is supplementary and read-only: nothing in it is required to complete a task, so screen-reader users lose nothing when it is not announced.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.
The card takes the link's theme and density and sits at z.popover.
